name: D5
tuning: D A D G B E
notes: Drop D: the bottom three open strings are a D power chord.

name: G5
tuning: D A D G B E
notes: One finger flat across the bottom three strings. The root is on string 6, two frets higher than in standard tuning.

name: D
tuning: D A D G B E
notes: Open D with all six strings ringing; the low D adds an octave under the chord.

name: D
tuning: D A D G B D
notes: Double drop D: both E strings down to D. The top-string F♯ is now at fret 4.

name: G
tuning: D A D G B D

name: Dsus4
tuning: D A D G A D
notes: DADGAD open is Dsus4 — neither major nor minor until you fret something.

name: D5
tuning: D A D G A D

name: D
tuning: D A D G A D

name: Gadd9
tuning: D A D G A D

name: G
tuning: D G D G B D
notes: Open G: the five upper strings are a G chord. Many open-G players leave the low D string off entirely.

name: C
tuning: D G D G B D
notes: One-finger major chord: barre any fret. Fret 5 = C, fret 7 = D.

name: C/G
tuning: D G D G B D
notes: The IV-over-I shape that open-G rhythm parts rock back and forth to from the open G.

name: D
tuning: D A D F# A D

name: G
tuning: D A D F# A D
notes: Barre fret 5 for the IV, fret 7 for the V.
